cards.name: Brilliant Restoration
cards.oracleText: Return all artifact and enchantment cards from your graveyard to the battlefield.

cards.name: Brilliance Unleashed
cards.oracleText:
Choose one or both —
• Brilliance Unleashed deals 5 damage to target creature.
• Choose target artifact card in your graveyard. Return it to the battlefield if it's an artifact creature card. Otherwise, return it to the battlefield and it's a 3/3 Robot artifact creature with flying.

cards.name: Brilliant Ultimatum
cards.oracleText: Exile the top five cards of your library. An opponent separates those cards into two piles. You may play lands and cast spells from one of those piles. If you cast a spell this way, you cast it without paying its mana cost.

cards.name: Brilliant Halo
cards.oracleText:
Enchant creature
Enchanted creature gets +1/+2.
When this Aura is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, return it to its owner's hand.

cards.name: Gleam of Resistance
cards.oracleText:
Creatures you control get +1/+2 until end of turn. Untap those creatures.
Basic landcycling {1}{W} ({1}{W}, Discard this card: Search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.)

cards.name: Glittermonger
cards.oracleText: {T}: Create a Treasure token. (It's an artifact with "{T}, Sacrifice this token: Add one mana of any color.")

cards.name: Brilliant Spectrum
cards.oracleText: Converge — Draw X cards, where X is the number of colors of mana spent to cast this spell. Then discard two cards.

cards.name: Gleam of Authority
cards.oracleText:
Enchant creature
Enchanted creature gets +1/+1 for each +1/+1 counter on other creatures you control.
Enchanted creature has vigilance and "{W}, {T}: Bolster 1." (To bolster 1, choose a creature with the least toughness among creatures you control and put a +1/+1 counter on it.)

cards.name: Mirror Sheen
cards.oracleText: {1}{U/R}{U/R}: Copy target instant or sorcery spell that targets you. You may choose new targets for the copy.

cards.name: Brilliant Wings
cards.oracleText:
Flash
Enchant creature you control
Enchanted creature has flying and hexproof.
Whenever a creature you control enters, you may pay {1}. If you do, attach this Aura to that creature.
